verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a state business-filing office, so publishing exact statutory fee amounts is an applicable axis. The evidence pack shows payment methods (docs-8), a check voucher (docs-16) and a reference to 'paying all associated fees' for reinstatement (docs-19), but no cited page states any fee amount for any transaction. With no published amounts in evidence, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
